own_solution.law: W = p1 V1 ln(V2/V1) for slow isothermal ideal-gas expansion
assumptions: given p and V are initial values

defect_reasons.other: TC41F and T6073 extend the expansion past the stated 2x end point without restating that the continued part is slow and isothermal; the certified p1V1 ln(q) relies on reading it as a continuation of the same process, which is the natural but not the only reading.

notes: Verified: p1V1 = 1000 J; base 1000 ln2 = 693.147 J; R values 1000 ln 2.6 = 955.511, ln 3.4 -> 1223.78, ln 4.5 -> 1504.08 J. Temperature cancels (nR = p1V1/T), so C is correct and agrees with pass 1. Minimal pairs T4C17/T6073 ('second cylinder' vs 'this cylinder') and TEE4E/TC41F ('earlier experiment' vs 'this experiment') share 3.4 and differ only in attachment; TFCFF and TBCED are declared numeral-free controls. Pass-1 judgement unchanged.
